description: Set a reminder on the phone: at the time you give (on the phone's clock, see set_phone_time) a notification with the title and body arrives, whether or not an app is open. Give at (a time like 2026-11-14T09:00) or in_minutes, not both. repeat is none, daily or weekly. With Do Not Disturb or Focus on, it is kept in the notification shade without a banner. It arrives whatever the app notification permissions say, as a phone's own reminders do. Read what arrived with notifications. Fails with bad_time, bad_title, too_long, bad_repeat or too_many.

in_minutes.description: Minutes from now on the phone's clock (0 to 525600)

name: set_reminder
